name: Rune: Break
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Dealing damage reduces the target's DEF by 45.0% for 10s.

name: Rune: Collapse
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Dealing damage reduces the target's DEF by 20.0% for 10s, stacking up to 3.0 times.

name: Rune: Tempering
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Taking damage grants self +25.0% DEF for 10s, stacking up to 3.0 times.

name: Rune: Enrage
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Taking damage grants self +25.0% ATK for 10s, stacking up to 3.0 times.

name: Rune: Restoration
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Healing a target increases their DEF by 45.0% for 10s.

name: Rune: Inspiration
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Healing a target increases their ATK by 35.0% for 10s.

name: Rune: Resonance
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Healing a target grants self +45.0% ATK for 10s.

name: Rune: Frenzy
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Taking damage grants self +20.0% ATK and +20.0% DEF for 10s, stacking up to 3.0 times.

name: Rune: Riptide
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Dealing damage grants self +20.0% ATK and +20.0% DEF for 10s, stacking up to 3.0 times.

name: Rune: Benevolence
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: When HP falls below 25.0%, restores HP equal to 7.5% of Max HP per second for 10s.

name: Rune: Last Stand
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants self +15.0% ATK for every 20% HP lost.

name: Rune: Tenacity
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants self +4.0 DEF for every 20% HP lost.

name: Rune: Penetration
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Increases Damage Dealt by 100.0% against shielded targets.

name: Rune: Fatality
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Increases Damage Dealt by 100.0% against unshielded targets.

name: Rune: Blast
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Blast. Trigger an explosion centered on self at intervals, knocking back nearby enemy targets.

name: Rune: Corrosion
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Corrosion. Spawn a pool of [Venom] beneath self at intervals, reducing the DEF of enemy targets within it and dealing damage over time.

name: Rune: Thunderbolt
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Thunderbolt. Fire [Electric Orbs] outward from self at intervals, releasing chain lightning to deal DMG to enemies within a small area. The orbs disappear after being attacked.

name: Rune: Decay
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Decay. Create a [Decaying Swamp] around self at intervals, dealing continuous damage to enemies within the area and restoring HP to allies within it.

name: Rune: Wither
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Wither. Fire [Withering Beam] outward at intervals. The rays rotate continuously for a duration, dealing damage to enemies hit and reducing their Sanity.

name: Rune: Vengeance
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Revenge. When defeated, grant [Empowered] to nearby allies, increasing ATK, DEF, Movement Speed, and ATK Speed for a duration.

name: Rune: Glimmer
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Glimmer. Apply [Glimmer] to self at intervals. Upon taking damage while the state is active, end the state and trigger an explosion, dealing damage to enemies within range.

name: Rune: Sacrifice
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Sacrifice. When defeated, trigger an explosion, dealing damage to enemies within range.

name: Rune: Bloodbath
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Grants Primander Ability – Bloodbath. Restore HP when dealing damage.

name: Rune: Focus
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Dealing DMG grants self +20.0% ATK Speed, stacking up to 5.0 times. Resets upon switching targets.

name: Rune: Challenge
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Increases Damage Dealt by 25.0% for every 250.0 HP difference between self and the target when dealing damage, stacking up to 4.0 times.

name: Rune: Rescue
extraBuffDesc: Buff Effect: Healing a target grants them continuous healing, restoring 3.5% of Max HP per second for 5.0s.
